descriptions.normal: A simple, humble fisherman's side dish. Freshly caught fish is de-skinned and sliced, minced together with Snapdragon, mixed with miso and salt to form a batter, and then finally grilled. The lovely scent enters your nose long before the food enters your mouth. Three servings later, and you're still raring to go for more.
descriptions.suspicious: A simple, humble fisherman's side dish. The overabundance of salt and rank smell of fish roll like a storm through your olfactory senses. Please keep your hands steady — please.
descriptions.delicious: A simple, humble fisherman's side dish. Full of nutrition and flavor. The lightly charred, yellowed exterior wraps the tender insides — providing two pleasures at once! Fish paste was already quite delectable raw, and the charcoal grilling only makes it better.

effectTexts.normal: Decreases all party members' sprinting Stamina consumption by 20% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
effectTexts.suspicious: Decreases all party members' sprinting Stamina consumption by 15% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
effectTexts.delicious: Decreases all party members' sprinting Stamina consumption by 25% for 900s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
